title: QPB heartbeat line
description: One JSON object per line in heartbeat.ndjson. The worker emits progress lines via the v1.5.9 1B.0 phase-transition facade (run_state_lib.emit_phase_transition, at phase boundaries) and via bin/qpb_heartbeat.py (the keepalive / on-error / terminal moments). The phase field is the canonical slug from phase_identity (single source of truth) so a heartbeat's phase always matches the ::QPB:: sentinel by construction. The harness (plugins/quality-playbook-harness/) tails heartbeat.ndjson and applies state-machine transitions per references/STATE_MACHINE.md. This file is byte-identical to plugins/quality-playbook-harness/skills/quality-playbook-harness/schemas/heartbeat.schema.json — the cross-skill byte-equality contract is load-bearing (Council C-3 silent-drift risk) and pinned by bin/tests/test_harness_schemas.py.

ts.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp (Zulu, second precision). Append-only ordering invariant: later lines have ts >= earlier lines in the same file.

task_id.description: Task id matching the job manifest. Threaded from the worker prompt header (TASK_ID=<id>) or env var QPB_TASK_ID.

schema_version.description: Schema-version pin. Currently '1'. The harness warns on mismatch (Council C-3).

phase.description: Canonical phase slug from phase_identity (validation / exploration / generation / code-review / spec-audit / reconciliation / verification). Present on progress heartbeats; omitted on the terminal sentinel.

step.description: Specific step within the phase (e.g. 'keepalive', 'phase_start'). Present on progress heartbeats; omitted on the terminal sentinel.

status.description: Progress: STARTING / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / FAILED. Terminal sentinel (last line): COMPLETED / FAILED / ABANDONED.

result_file.description: Path of the terminal result file (quality/SUMMARY.md or equivalent). Present on the terminal sentinel; absent on progress lines.

summary.description: One-line outcome. Present on the terminal sentinel; absent on progress lines.
